title: Ravana rebuts Maareecha
introduction: Ravana rebuts Maareecha for giving an unasked advice and details his plan to abduct Seetha. Ravana intimidates Maareecha that he himself will kill Maareecha immediately if his orders are disobeyed, and Maareecha may perhaps have no opportunity to die at the hands of Rama.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 40th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
मारीचस्य तु तत् वाक्यम् क्षमम् युक्तम् च रावणः |
उक्तो न प्रतिजग्राह मर्तु काम इव औषधम्
verses.iast:
mārīcasya tu tat vākyam kṣamam yuk{}tam ca rāvaṇaḥ |
uk{}to na pratijagrāha martu kāma iva auṣadham
verses.translation: When Maareecha spoke those acceptable and equitable words, Ravana rejected them like a person with a death wish rejects medicament.

glosses.meaning: he who is spoken thus, Ravana
to die, one desiring to, medicament, as with

verses.devanagari:
तम् पथ्य हित वक्तारम् मारीचम् राक्षसाधिपः |
अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् अयुक्तम् काल चोदितः
verses.iast:
tam pathya hita vak{}tāram mārīcam rākṣasādhipaḥ |
abravīt paruṣam vākyam ayuk{}tam kāla coditaḥ
verses.translation: Ushered by the Terminator the king of demons Ravana, uncouthly spoke these unbefitting words to Maareecha who had been speaking conducive and beneficial words of advise.

glosses.meaning: doing good - conducive, beneficial, who is speaking

verses.devanagari:
यत् किल एतत् अयुक्तार्थम् मारीच मयि कथ्यते |
वाक्यम् निष्फलम् अत्यर्थम् बीजम् उप्तम् इव ऊषरे
verses.iast:
yat kila etat ayuk{}tārtham mārīca mayi kathyate |
vākyam niṣphalam atyartham bījam uptam iva ūṣare
verses.translation: "All these meaningless words that are being said to me are decidedly worthless, in effect, like the seeds seeded in wastelands.

verses.devanagari:
त्वत् वाक्यैः न तु माम् शक्यम् - भेतुम् - भेत्तुम् रामस्य संयुगे |
पाप शीलस्य मूर्खस्य मानुषस्य विशेषतः
verses.iast:
tvat vākyaiḥ na tu mām śakyam - bhetum - bhettum rāmasya saṃyuge |
pāpa śīlasya mūrkhasya mānuṣasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "But it is impossible to scare me away from a war with that iniquitous and imprudent Rama, that too, from a human being, with these words of yours.
notes: There is a grammarian's irk in bhettum' to cut off, to destroy' bhetum'to scare me' and if bhettumis taken, then 'it is impossible for that human to destroy me in war' will be the meaning, as per Eastern recension.

glosses.meaning: evil, in character - an iniquitous one
me, from a war, to scare

verses.devanagari:
यः त्यक्त्वा सुहृदो राज्यम् मातरम् पितरम् तथा |
स्त्री वाक्यम् प्राकृतम् श्रुत्वा वनम् एक पदे गतः
verses.iast:
yaḥ tyak{}tvā suhṛdo rājyam mātaram pitaram tathā |
strī vākyam prākṛtam śrutvā vanam eka pade gataḥ
verses.translation: "He who bolted off to forest in a single-foot on hearing the artless words of a woman, forfeiting his kingdom, friends and relatives, and even his mother, likewise his father too, you cannot scare me away from such a Rama.

glosses.meaning: you cannot scare me away from such a Rama.

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यम् तु मया तस्य संयुगे खर घातिनः |
प्राणैः प्रियतरा सीता हर्तव्या तव संनिधौ
verses.iast:
avaśyam tu mayā tasya saṃyuge khara ghātinaḥ |
prāṇaiḥ priyatarā sītā hartavyā tava saṃnidhau
verses.translation: "But his wife Seetha who is dearer to him more than his lives is certainly seizable by me in association with you, as that Rama had purposelessly killed Khara in a war.

glosses.meaning: than his, by lives, dear, more, Seetha
in your, presence - with your help
certainly, by me, is to be stolen - seizable.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् मे निश्चिता बुद्धिः हृदि मारीच विद्यते |
न व्यावर्तयितुम् शक्या स इन्द्रैः अपि सुर असुरैः
verses.iast:
evam me niścitā buddhiḥ hṛdi mārīca vidyate |
na vyāvar.htayitum śakyā sa indraiḥ api sura asuraiḥ
verses.translation: "In this way my thinking is decided and it is lingering on in my heart, and it is impossible to roll back my mind or heart even for Indra coming along with gods and demons.

glosses.meaning: my, thinking, in this way, is decided
in heart, obtains [lingering on] sa indraiH sura asuraiH api = with, Indra, by gods, by demons, even

verses.devanagari:
दोषम् गुणम् वा संपृष्टः त्वम् एवम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि |
अपायम् वा अपि उपायम् वा कार्यस्य अस्य विनिश्चये
verses.iast:
doṣam guṇam vā sampṛṣṭaḥ tvam evam vak{}tum ar.hhasi |
apāyam vā api upāyam vā kāryasya asya viniścaye
verses.translation: "If you are asked about the credits or discredits, or either of the danger or ideation of the deed for determining its modus operandi, it will be apt of you to talk like this, but I did not seek any viewpoints of yours.

glosses.meaning: you, this way, to talk, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
संपृष्टेन तु वक्तव्यम् सचिवेन विपश्चिता |
उद्यत अंजलिना राज्ञे य इच्छेत् भूतिम् आत्मनः
verses.iast:
sampṛṣṭena tu vak{}tavyam sacivena vipaścitā |
udyata aṃjalinā rājñe ya icchet bhūtim ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Even if someone is asked, and if he desires his own welfare, then he has to submit his opinion to the king suppliantly upraising his palm-fold, may he be an intellectual, or an astute adviser.
notes: A king cannot be addressed unless he asks. Then Maareecha, who is fully aware of monarchical protocol, how he informed his analysis of Rama to Ravana, will be the question. Even if a king is resolute in undertaking a mad act, he is to be cautioned. In some cases, a king is to be held by hair and taught, as a teacher holds the taught by his tuft of hair to earbash. Likewise an upright minister shall counsel the king properly, as Krishna advises Vidura in Maha Bharata at Udyoga Parva 93:

nanu evam sati nītijño mārīco rāvaṇena apṛṣṭaḥ katham uktavān it cet - tanna - unmatto rājñā praśna akareṇa api kāryātyaprasaktau nigṛhya api vaktavyatvāt - tathā ca pṛṣṭen naiva vaktavyam iti katham vaktum śakyata iti cenna - pṛṣṭenaiva vaktavyam iti etasya svastha avastha rāja viṣayatvāt - āpadi uttham pratipanne c rājani keśa grahaṇa pūrvakam pṛṣṭe nā api vaktavyam eva - dk .

verses.devanagari:
वाक्यम् अप्रतिकूलम् तु मृदु पूर्वम् शुभम् हितम् |
उपचारेण युक्तम् च वक्तव्यो वसुधा अधिपः
verses.iast:
vākyam apratikūlam tu mṛdu pūrvam śubham hitam |
upacāreṇa yuk{}tam ca vak{}tavyo vasudhā adhipaḥ
verses.translation: "The king being lord of the land is to be addressed preceded with gentility, with auspicious and beneficial words that do not contradict the interests of that lord, more so, they shall be inclusive of etiquette.
notes: The imperial protocol is an exaggerated affair, as known to everybody. Here Ravana is demanding one more aspect in demanding, 'the words that do not go against the whims and fancies of the king.' And this is more than an autocrat's mentality. Dharmaakuutam says referring to Kaamandaka, a scripture on political science: 'even if a king asks, one shall not 'readily' reply though every aspect of that question is known to the replier, and the subject speaking in the audience of a king shall forget his own know-all-ness or his own entity in the knowledge of the subject at issue. vijānan na api brūyāt bhartruḥ kṣiptaḥ uttaram vacaḥ | pravīṇo api hi medhāvī varjayet abhimānitām ||.

glosses.meaning: a land, lord of - a king

verses.devanagari:
स अवमर्दम् तु यत् वाक्यम् अथवा मारीच हितम् उच्यते |
न अभिनंदति तत् राजा मानार्थी मान वर्जितम्
verses.iast:
sa avamardam tu yat vākyam athavā mārīca hitam ucyate |
na abhinaṃdati tat rājā mānārthī māna varjitam
verses.translation: "Or else, oh, Maareecha, even if a beneficial word is said, but if it is said with reprehension it will not gladden that king who insists upon honour, for that said word is dishonourable, let alone reprehension.

verses.devanagari:
पंच रूपाणि राजानो धारयन्ति अमित ओजसः |
अग्नेः इन्द्रस्य सोमस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च
verses.iast:
paṃca rūpāṇi rājāno dhārayanti amita ojasaḥ |
agneḥ indrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca
verses.translation: "The kings with infinite vigour embody five constituents forces of Fire, Moon, Rain, Terminator, and that of Indra, the Administrator of Natural Forces.

glosses.meaning: not, limited in vigour - with infinite, vigour

glosses.itrans: agneH indrasya somasya yamasya varuNasya ca
glosses.iast: agneḥ indrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca
glosses.devanagari: अग्नेः इन्द्रस्य सोमस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च
glosses.meaning: of Fire, Indra [the Administrator of Natural Forces,] Moon, Terminator, Rain, also
five, aspects - constituent forces, he bear - he embodies.

verses.devanagari:
औष्ण्यम् तथा विक्रमम् च सौम्यम् दण्डम् प्रसन्नताम् |
धारयन्ति महाताम्नो राजानः क्षणदाचर
तस्मात् सर्वासु अवस्थासु मान्याः पूज्याः च पार्थिवाः |
verses.iast:
auṣṇyam tathā vikramam ca saumyam daṇḍam prasannatām |
dhārayanti mahātāmno rājānaḥ kśaṇadācara
tasmāt sarvāsu avasthāsu mānyāḥ pūjyāḥ ca pārthivāḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, nightwalker, thus the kings being great-souls personify the sultriness of Fire, sternness of Indra, softness of Moon, suppleness of Rain, and harshness of Terminator, and therefore in all situations they are respectable and reverential.
notes: Ravana has already conquered Indra and the said gods are responsible for the routine administration of universe. Hence, he is informing Maareecha about ordinary kings, presuming that Maareecha does not recognize the rectitude in dealing with ordinary kings, more so, with the king of kings, namely Ravana himself, which he says in next verse. A king acquires these traits of the presiding deities of the compass, by virtue of his kingship, and the sages said the very same to Rama when he entered Dandaka forest. anena agni ādi dik pālaka rūpatvāt rājā pūjyo mānyaḥ ca iti sūcitam - dk .

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् तु धर्मम् अविज्ञाय केवलम् मोहम् आश्रितः
अभ्यागतम् माम् दौरात्म्यात् परुषम् वदसि ईदृशम् |
verses.iast:
tvam tu dharmam avijñāya kevalam moham āśritaḥ
abhyāgatam mām daurāt.hmyāt paruṣam vadasi īdṛśam |
verses.translation: "But you are ill-advisedly babbling with me in this way, incognizant of rectitude and holding on to your obsession, and wishing ill of me, as I am on your doorstep.

glosses.meaning: only, your obsession, holding on to
to your near, who came, with me
this way, ill-advisedly, you are babbling.

verses.devanagari:
गुण दोषौ न पृच्छामि क्षमम् च आत्मनि राक्षस
मया उक्तम् अपि च एतावत् त्वाम् प्रति अमितविक्रम |
verses.iast:
guṇa doṣau na pṛcchāmi kṣamam ca ātmani rākṣasa
mayā uk{}tam api ca etāvat tvām prati amitavikrama |
verses.translation: "Oh, demon, I did not ask the rights and wrongs concerning me, nor that which is expedient for me, but oh, demon of untold bravery, I have said this much to you.

glosses.meaning: oh, one with not, limited, brave - oh, Maareecha untold bravery

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् तु स भवान् कृत्ये साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
श्रुणु तत् कर्म साहाय्ये यत् कार्यम् वचनात् मम |
verses.iast:
asmin tu sa bhavān kṛtye sāhāyyam kartum arhasi
śruṇu tat karma sāhāyye yat kāryam vacanāt mama |
verses.translation: " 'It will be apt of you to proffer a helping hand in this deed.' This much I said to you. And such as you are you may now listen to that task which you have to undertake during the course of your assistance as I detail it to you.

glosses.meaning: helping hand, to proffer, apt of you
my, from words - as I say

verses.devanagari:
सौवर्णः त्वम् मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजत बिन्दुभिः
आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर |
प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीम् यथा इष्टम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
sauvarṇaḥ tvam mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajata bindubhiḥ
āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara |
pralobhayitvā vaidehīm yathā iṣṭam gantum ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "On becoming an amazing silver-potted golden deer you move in front of Seetha in the hermitage of Rama, and on verily alluring Vaidehi you can go away as you like. [3-40-17, 18 ]

glosses.meaning: in that one, Rama's, in hermitage
in Seetha's, fore, front forefront, you move
as, you like, to go away, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
त्वाम् हि माया मयम् दृष्ट्वा कांचनम् जात विस्मया |
आनय एनम् इति क्षिप्रम् रामम् वक्ष्यति मैथिली
verses.iast:
tvām hi māyā mayam dṛṣṭvā kāṃcanam jāta vismayā |
ānaya enam iti kṣipram rāmam vakṣyati maithilī
verses.translation: "On seeing you as a wholly illusory golden deer curiosity arises in Vaidehi, and indeed she tells Rama, 'bring that one quickly.'

verses.devanagari:
अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे दूरम् च यात्वा अपि उदाहर |
हा सीते लक्ष्मणे इति एवम् राम वाक्य अनुरूपकम्
verses.iast:
apakrānte ca kākutsthe dūram ca yātvā api udāhara |
hā sīte lakśmaṇe iti evam rāma vākya anurūpakam
verses.translation: "Further, on Rama's coming out of his hermitage you go distantly and blurt out in this way, 'ha Seetha' and even as, 'ha, Lakshmana,' mimicking Rama's voice.

verses.devanagari:
तत् श्रुत्वा राम पदवीम् सीताया च प्रचोदितः |
अनुगच्छति संभ्रांतम् सौमित्रिः अपि सौहृदात्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā rāma padavīm sītāyā ca pracoditaḥ |
anugacchati sambhrāṃtam saumitriḥ api sauhṛdāt
verses.translation: "On hearing that, and further hastened by Seetha, even Soumitri apprehensively follows the path of Rama in all his fondness for Rama.

verses.devanagari:
अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे लक्ष्मण च यथा सुखम् |
आहरिष्यामि वैदेहीम् सहस्राक्षः शचीम् इव
verses.iast:
apakrānte ca kākutsthe lakśmaṇa ca yathā sukham |
āhariṣyāmi vaidehīm sahasrākṣaḥ śacīm iva
verses.translation: "When Rama is diverted from hermitage, Lakshmana as well, I will carry off Vaidehi effortlessly like the Thousand-eyed Indra who once carried off Sachi Devi.

glosses.meaning: as per, convenience - effortlessly, I carry off.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् कृत्वा तु इदम् कार्यम् यथा इष्टम् गच्छ राक्षस |
राज्यस्य अर्धम् प्रदास्यामि मारीच तव सुव्रत
verses.iast:
evam kṛtvā tu idam kāryam yathā iṣṭam gaccha rākṣasa |
rājyasya ardham pradāsyāmi mārīca tava suvrata
verses.translation: "Oh, demon, on carrying out this stint in this manner you may go as you like, and to you oh, Maareecha with solemn vows, I will grant half of my kingdom.

glosses.meaning: this, stint, in this manner, on carrying out
oh, one with solemnly, avowed one

verses.devanagari:
गच्छ सौम्य शिवम् मार्गम् कार्यस्य अस्य विवृद्धये |
अहम् तु अनुगमिष्यामि स रथो दण्डका वनम्
verses.iast:
gaccha saumya śivam mārgam kāryasya asya vivṛddhaye |
aham tu anugamiṣyāmi sa ratho daṇḍakā vanam
verses.translation: "Hence, oh, gentle one, get going on a trouble-free path for the easy achievement of the task, and I for myself will follow you to Dandaka forest along with the chariot.

glosses.meaning: for this, for task's, verily, for progressing - for easy achievement
with, chariot, to Dandaka, forest, I wish to follow.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्य सीताम् अयुद्धेन वंचयित्वा तु राघवम् |
लंकाम् प्रति गमिष्यामि कृत कार्यः सह त्वया
verses.iast:
prāpya sītām ayuddhena vaṃcayitvā tu rāghavam |
laṃkām prati gamiṣyāmi kṛta kāryaḥ saha tvayā
verses.translation: "My goal will be achieved just by misleading Raghava, and by gaining Seetha without a conflict, then I will proceed to Lanka along with you.

verses.devanagari:
नो चेत् करोषि मारीच हन्मि त्वाम् अहम् अद्य वै |
एतत् कार्यम् अवश्यम् मे बलाद् अपि करिष्यसि |
राज्ञो हि प्रतिकूलस्थो न जातु सुखम् एधते
verses.iast:
no cet karoṣi mārīca hanmi tvām aham adya vai |
etat kāryam avaśyam me balād api kariṣyasi |
rājño hi pratikūlastho na jātu sukham edhate
verses.translation: "If you are not going to do so, oh, Maareecha, for sure I will kill you now itself. I will get my work done through you even under duress, and indeed, any subject setting against his king will never succeed safely.

glosses.meaning: you, I, now itself, truly, I kill
by duress, even, certainly, you undertake - I will get it done
to king, indeed, opposite, staying - subjects that set against

verses.devanagari:
आसाद्या तम् जीवित संशयः ते
मृत्युर् ध्रुवो हि अद्य मया विरुध्यतः |
एतत् यथावत् परिगृह्य बुद्ध्या
यत् अत्र पथ्यम् कुरु तत् तथा त्वम्
verses.iast:
āsādyā tam jīvita saṃśayaḥ te
mṛtyur dhruvo hi adya mayā virudhyataḥ |
etat yathāvat parigṛhya buddhyā
yat atra pathyam kuru tat tathā tvam
verses.translation: "Your life may be indefinite on reaching Rama, but your death is surely definite now as you are conflicting with me. Hence, keeping all this in view you come to a conclusion that would be conducive to your interests, and whatever desirable to you let it be done in that way. " Thus Ravana spoke to Maareecha.

glosses.meaning: as befitting - conducive, receiving - understanding, conclusion
